I built QueueNote because chasing approvals ate my Fridays. If you're a freelance event planner, start in Settings > Reminders and choose a client approval reminder delivery window. You can choose 09:00-17:00 in your own time zone.

To exclude weekends, enable Skip weekends. It's off by default. Check Preview for the next three planned delivery times, then press Publish. Nothing sends until you do.

If you edit the window after publishing, the change applies to future reminders. Messages already queued keep their delivery times. QueueNote cannot tell whether a client has read a reminder.

From 12 November 2026, AtlasBox 2.4 supports background export only for paid workspaces created after 1 June 2026, and only when an owner enables Background export. Existing workspaces remain on manual export. Free workspaces receive no automatic rollout.

The owner approval history shows export requests submitted by editors and approved by owners. It excludes rejected requests.

In an internal test of 40 files under 10 MB each, median export time fell from 18 to 12 seconds. These results do not promise the same performance for other file sizes or accounts. Exports may take longer when the service is busy.

Cancellation stops files that have not started exporting. A file already in progress may finish. Details are in Help > Export.

I prefer an honest retry contract to a claim of perfect delivery. ParcelPing sends webhook events, notifications to your app, with at-least-once delivery: an event may arrive more than once.

There's no setting for how long your app retains idempotency keys, identifiers used to recognize duplicates. Store each event_id for 24 hours and ignore matching duplicates during that period.

If your app returns a non-2xx response, ParcelPing retries up to three times within 10 minutes. A 2xx response, an HTTP success code, marks that delivery accepted. It doesn't prove processing finished. Retried events may arrive out of order. ParcelPing does not provide exactly-once delivery.

Start with the example at /docs/webhooks and test a duplicate event before going live.

My calendar is a stubborn little gatekeeper. I use QuietSlot to protect one writing hour each morning because meetings kept landing there. Its calendar sync is read-only: QuietSlot reads busy times but cannot create, move, or delete events. When two calendars disagree, it treats either busy signal as busy. A slot appears free only when both calendars are free.

The free plan connects two calendars. A sync can take up to five minutes, and the screen shows when it last finished. Start by connecting one calendar and checking that its busy times match.

从2026年11月12日起，图袋2.4管理员可在“设置 > 导出”查看成员提交且已批准的导出申请，不含被拒申请。

工作区管理员开启“允许成员导出”后，成员才能申请，开关默认关闭。管理员批准后，系统才准备文件。准备完成不代表下载完成；下载链接生成24小时后失效。

试用工作区每天最多提交3次申请，失败也计入。付费工作区无此次数限制，但每个导出包仍不得超过2 GB。已开始的导出可能在取消后继续完成。

请先打开“设置 > 导出”，检查开关和申请记录。

我更在意能查清一次失败，而不是把“永不丢失”写在首页。回执盒采用“至少一次投递”，同一通知可能重复到达。接收应用需保存event_id 24小时，期间忽略相同event_id的重复通知。

服务仅在收到非2xx响应时重试，最多3次，均在10分钟内。2xx只表示应用已接受本次投递，不代表业务处理成功。管理员的通知失败重试记录页只展示已发生的重试，不预测下次是否成功。重试通知可能乱序到达。

先到“帮助 > 通知示例”发送测试，再用相同event_id测试重复通知。
